en.summary: Drop discs into columns and connect four before your friends do.
en.title: Stack Four

zh-Hans.summary: 把棋子落入列中，先连成四子即可获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 四连叠

en.summary: Take one, two, or three stones. Whoever takes the final stone loses.
en.title: Last One Loses

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合拿走一、二或三颗石子，拿走最后一颗的人输。
zh-Hans.title: 最后一个输

en.summary: Take turns sliding numbered tiles into the empty space and restore the grid.
en.title: Pocket Slider

zh-Hans.summary: 轮流将数字滑入空格，在步数用尽前还原方阵。
zh-Hans.title: 掌上华容格

en.summary: Swap neighboring prisms, clear matching lines, and outscore your friends.
en.title: Prism Shift

zh-Hans.summary: 交换相邻棱镜，连成同色消除，在十六回合内赢得最高分。
zh-Hans.title: 棱镜交换

en.summary: Take one, two, or three tokens. The last move wins.
en.title: Take Five

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合拿走一、二或三个标记，拿走最后一个的人获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 拿五

en.summary: Take one, two, or four embers from the hearth; the player taking the final ember wins.
en.title: Ember Count

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合从炉火取走一、二或四枚余烬，拿到最后一枚者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 余烬计数

en.summary: Take one or two sparks, but the player taking the final spark loses.
en.title: Lantern Lose

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合取走一或两点火花，但取到最后一点火花者落败。
zh-Hans.title: 灯火失手

en.summary: Pluck one, three, or five moss stones; the player who clears the stone bed wins.
en.title: Moss Last

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合取走一、三或五枚苔石，清空石堆者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 苔石收官

en.summary: Scoop two or four shells from the tide pool; the player taking the last shell wins.
en.title: Quiet Tide

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合从潮池取走两枚或四枚贝壳，取到最后一枚者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 静潮拾贝

en.summary: Choose one, two, three, or five cinders from the shared brazier; the final cinder wins the round.
en.title: Cinder Choice

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合从火盆取走一、二、三或五枚炭火，拿到最后一枚者赢得本局。
zh-Hans.title: 炭火择取

en.summary: Pull one, two, or five buoys from the harbor line; whoever takes the last buoy wins.
en.title: Harbor Pull

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合从港湾浮标线取走一、二或五枚浮标，拿到最后一枚者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 港湾牵引

en.summary: Pick one, four, or six apples from the orchard ladder; the player picking the last apple wins.
en.title: Orchard Ladder

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合从果园取走一、四或六枚苹果，拿到最后一枚者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 果园梯影

en.summary: Take one, three, or four copper discs, but avoid taking the final disc.
en.title: Copper Avoid

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合取走一、三或四枚铜片，但取到最后一枚者落败。
zh-Hans.title: 铜片避终

en.summary: Cross the ice by removing one, three, or seven markers; the final marker wins.
en.title: Glacier Steps

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合取走一、三或七枚冰标，拿到最后一枚者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 冰川步幅

en.summary: Pass the moonlight by taking one, two, five, or eight beams; the final beam wins.
en.title: Moon Relay

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合取走一、二、五或八束月光，拿到最后一束者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 月光接力

en.summary: Drain one, two, or three drops from the gauge, but the player draining the final drop loses.
en.title: Rain Gauge

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合排出一、二或三滴雨水，但排出最后一滴者落败。
zh-Hans.title: 雨量避底

en.summary: Ferry one, four, or nine echoes across the river; the final echo wins.
en.title: Echo Ferry

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合渡走一、四或九道回声，送走最后一道者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 回声渡口

en.summary: Gather one, two, six, or seven stars from the shared sky; the final star wins.
en.title: Star Harvest

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合从星空取走一、二、六或七颗星，拿到最后一颗者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 星野收获

en.summary: Snuff one or four candles, but the player extinguishing the final flame loses.
en.title: Candle Keep

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合熄灭一或四支蜡烛，但熄灭最后一支者落败。
zh-Hans.title: 烛火留存

en.summary: Untie one, three, five, or eight knots from the shared rope; the final knot wins.
en.title: River Knots

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合从共用绳索解开一、三、五或八个结，解开最后一个者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 河绳解结

en.summary: Lift one, six, or ten comet stones from orbit; the final stone wins.
en.title: Comet Lift

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合从轨道取走一、六或十枚彗石，拿到最后一枚者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 彗石升轨

en.summary: Move one, two, four, or seven pebbles out of orbit, but taking the final pebble loses.
en.title: Pebble Orbit

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合移出一、二、四或七枚卵石，但拿到最后一枚者落败。
zh-Hans.title: 卵石离轨

en.summary: Cut one, three, eight, or nine bamboo marks; the player cutting the final mark wins.
en.title: Bamboo Count

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合取走一、三、八或九根竹筹，拿到最后一根者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 竹筹计数

en.summary: Collect one, five, or six signal tokens from the cache; the final token wins.
en.title: Signal Cache

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合从缓存取走一、五或六枚信号标记，拿到最后一枚者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 信号缓存

en.summary: Remove one, two, six, or eleven stones, but the player taking the final stone loses.
en.title: Quarry Mercy

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合取走一、二、六或十一枚石头，但拿到最后一枚者落败。
zh-Hans.title: 石场留手

en.summary: Clip one, four, five, or twelve vine rungs; the player clipping the final rung wins.
en.title: Vine Ladder

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合剪下一、四、五或十二节藤梯，剪下最后一节者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 藤梯裁节

en.summary: Carry one, seven, or eight ice tokens across the relay; the final token wins.
en.title: Polar Relay

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合运送一、七或八枚冰标，送走最后一枚者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 极地接力

en.summary: Clear one, three, or ten mist rings, but the player clearing the final ring loses.
en.title: Mist Keep

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合清除一、三或十圈薄雾，但清除最后一圈者落败。
zh-Hans.title: 雾环留守

en.summary: Collect one, two, seven, or twelve amber steps; the final step wins.
en.title: Amber Steps

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合取走一、二、七或十二枚琥珀阶，拿到最后一枚者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 琥珀阶梯

en.summary: Wind one, four, seven, ten, or thirteen gears from the cache; the final gear wins.
en.title: Clockwork Cache

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合取走一、四、七、十或十三枚齿轮，拿到最后一枚者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 发条缓存

en.summary: Ring one, five, or twelve bells, but the player ringing the final bell loses.
en.title: Bell Reserve

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合敲响一、五或十二口钟，但敲响最后一口者落败。
zh-Hans.title: 钟声留响

en.summary: Lift one, three, eight, or fourteen tide markers; the final marker wins.
en.title: Tide Markers

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合取走一、三、八或十四枚潮汐标记，拿到最后一枚者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 潮汐标记

en.summary: Weave one, five, nine, fourteen, or fifteen sun threads; the final thread wins.
en.title: Solar Loom

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合织走一、五、九、十四或十五缕日光，拿到最后一缕者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 日光织机

en.summary: Clear one, six, or thirteen drift markers, but the player taking the final marker loses.
en.title: Drift Reserve

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合清除一、六或十三枚漂流标记，但拿到最后一枚者落败。
zh-Hans.title: 漂流留标

en.summary: Collect one, four, nine, or fifteen aurora markers; the final marker wins.
en.title: Aurora Markers

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合取走一、四、九或十五枚极光标记，拿到最后一枚者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 极光标记

en.summary: Weave one, three, six, eleven, or sixteen orbit threads; the final thread wins.
en.title: Orbit Weave

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合织走一、三、六、十一或十六缕轨道线，拿到最后一缕者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 轨道织线

en.summary: Melt one, seven, or fourteen frost marks, but the player melting the final mark loses.
en.title: Frost Reserve

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合融去一、七或十四枚霜痕，但融去最后一枚者落败。
zh-Hans.title: 霜痕留存

en.summary: Gather one, five, ten, or sixteen meadow tokens; the final token wins.
en.title: Meadow Count

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合取走一、五、十或十六枚草甸标记，拿到最后一枚者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 草甸计数

en.summary: Lift one, four, seven, thirteen, or seventeen quartz steps; the final step wins.
en.title: Quartz Ladder

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合取走一、四、七、十三或十七枚石英阶，拿到最后一枚者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 石英阶梯

en.summary: Clear one, eight, or fifteen dune markers, but the player clearing the final marker loses.
en.title: Dune Reserve

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合清除一、八或十五枚沙丘标记，但清除最后一枚者落败。
zh-Hans.title: 沙丘留标

en.summary: Gather one, six, eleven, or seventeen cedar tokens; the final token wins.
en.title: Cedar Count

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合取走一、六、十一或十七枚雪松标记，拿到最后一枚者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 雪松计数

en.summary: Weave one, three, nine, fourteen, or eighteen cloud threads; the final thread wins.
en.title: Nimbus Loom

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合织走一、三、九、十四或十八缕云线，拿到最后一缕者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 云幕织机

en.summary: Clear one, nine, or sixteen delta markers, but the player clearing the final marker loses.
en.title: Delta Reserve

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合清除一、九或十六枚三角洲标记，但清除最后一枚者落败。
zh-Hans.title: 三角洲留标

en.summary: Gather one, seven, twelve, or eighteen juniper tokens; the final token wins.
en.title: Juniper Count

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合取走一、七、十二或十八枚杜松标记，拿到最后一枚者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 杜松计数

en.summary: Weave one, four, ten, fifteen, or nineteen halo threads; the final thread wins.
en.title: Halo Loom

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合织走一、四、十、十五或十九缕光环线，拿到最后一缕者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 光环织机

en.summary: Clear one, ten, or seventeen canyon markers, but the player clearing the final marker loses.
en.title: Canyon Reserve

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合清除一、十或十七枚峡谷标记，但清除最后一枚者落败。
zh-Hans.title: 峡谷留标

en.summary: Gather one, eight, thirteen, or nineteen willow tokens; the final token wins.
en.title: Willow Count

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合取走一、八、十三或十九枚柳叶标记，拿到最后一枚者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 柳叶计数

en.summary: Weave one, five, eleven, sixteen, or twenty zenith threads; the final thread wins.
en.title: Zenith Loom

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合织走一、五、十一、十六或二十缕天顶线，拿到最后一缕者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 天顶织机

en.summary: Clear one, eleven, or eighteen ridge markers, but the player clearing the final marker loses.
en.title: Ridge Reserve

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合清除一、十一或十八枚山脊标记，但清除最后一枚者落败。
zh-Hans.title: 山脊留标

en.summary: Gather one, ten, fourteen, or twenty alder tokens; the final token wins.
en.title: Alder Count

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合取走一、十、十四或二十枚桤木标记，拿到最后一枚者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 桤木计数

en.summary: Weave one, six, twelve, seventeen, or twenty-one meridian threads; the final thread wins.
en.title: Meridian Loom

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合织走一、六、十二、十七或二十一缕经线，拿到最后一缕者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 经线织机

en.summary: Clear one, twelve, or nineteen channel markers, but the player clearing the final marker loses.
en.title: Fjord Reserve

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合清除一、十二或十九枚航道标记，但清除最后一枚者落败。
zh-Hans.title: 峡湾留标

en.summary: Take one, nine, fifteen, or twenty-two copper rings; whoever takes the final ring wins.
en.title: Copper Count

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合拿取一、九、十五或二十二枚铜环，拿到最后一枚者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 铜环计数

en.summary: Pass the turn after collecting one, six, thirteen, nineteen, or twenty-three orbit tokens; the final collector wins.
en.title: Orbit Relay

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合收取一、六、十三、十九或二十三枚轨道标记并交棒，收取最后一枚者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 轨道接力

en.summary: Remove one, ten, sixteen, or twenty-three harbor buoys, but whoever removes the final buoy loses.
en.title: Harbor Reserve

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合移除一、十、十六或二十三枚港湾浮标，但移除最后一枚者落败。
zh-Hans.title: 港湾留标

en.summary: Collect one, seven, fourteen, twenty, or twenty-four garnets; the player collecting the final stone wins.
en.title: Garnet Count

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合收取一、七、十四、二十或二十四枚石榴石，收取最后一枚者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 石榴石计数

en.summary: Pass the turn after dimming one, eight, fourteen, twenty-one, or twenty-five aurora lights; dimming the final light loses.
en.title: Aurora Relay

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合熄灭一、八、十四、二十一或二十五束极光并交棒，熄灭最后一束者落败。
zh-Hans.title: 极光接力

en.summary: Collect one, eleven, eighteen, or twenty-six beacon chips; the player collecting the final chip wins.
en.title: Beacon Count

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合收取一、十一、十八或二十六枚灯塔标记，收取最后一枚者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 灯塔计数

en.summary: Remove one, thirteen, nineteen, or twenty-six ice markers, but whoever removes the final marker loses.
en.title: Glacier Reserve

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合移除一、十三、十九或二十六枚冰川标记，但移除最后一枚者落败。
zh-Hans.title: 冰川留标

en.summary: Pass the turn after gathering one, seven, sixteen, twenty-three, or twenty-seven comet sparks; the final gatherer wins.
en.title: Comet Relay

zh-Hans.summary: 每回合收集一、七、十六、二十三或二十七枚彗星火花并交棒，收集最后一枚者获胜。
zh-Hans.title: 彗星接力
